purpose: Define retrieval result as derived evidence linking exact query/context need to exact memory records and relevance profile.

topics.name: Memory Retrieval Evidence
topics.purpose: Define retrieval result as derived evidence linking exact query/context need to exact memory records and relevance profile.

semantics.source_rule: Returned memory record identities are exact.
semantics.score_rule: Relevance score is derived evidence only.
semantics.stale_rule: Superseded/expired/forgotten records are excluded or explicitly marked according to profile.
semantics.authority_rule: Retrieved content does not gain elevated authority because it was selected.

invariants.rule: Machine-significant identity, type, relation, state and meaning are explicit and never inferred solely from display text, path, layout, file order, timestamp or implementation accident.
Resolved, projected, indexed, cached, formatted or derived representations never become source-of-truth or authority merely because they are convenient or available.
